# `company.scheduled_revision_authority`

The authority an agent held when it saved a memorized transaction revision, so the scheduler applies a token's checks to it.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Memorized transaction revision an agent saved. |
| `agent_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | The agent that saved it. |
| `principal_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The person the agent acted for when it saved it. |
| `authority_epoch` | INTEGER | yes | — | — | — | — | The agent's authority epoch at the save; the scheduler replays the revision only while it is unchanged, as a bearer token is honoured only for its own epoch. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time the revision was saved. |
